speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe the nature of your generalized fatigue and when your severe itching began, noting if it worsens at night or affects your sleep. Also, have you noticed any changes in your skin color, stool color, or urine darkening?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chagas disease with secondary hypergammaglobulinemic pruritus and portal hypertension.
